name: Monokai
description: The Monokai palette of Wimer Hazenberg, dark background.
notCovered: The editor font reaches only the program editors opened after the theme, and not at all when the FoxPro resource (FOXUSER) has its own default font (Edit > Properties > Use as default) or for a file that already has its own window record there: FoxDock does not write the resource. Not covered: the debugger windows, the Command window, the method editors of the designers and the text and memo editors (not tried with a theme).
